# Archive test fixtures

`test-v4.rar` and `test-v5.rar` come from the MIT-licensed libarchivejs tests:

- https://github.com/nika-begiashvili/libarchivejs/tree/master/test/files/archives/rar
- Original license is preserved in `LICENSE`.

These files exercise real RAR4 and RAR5 decoding. They are never executed.
